summary: Renovate bump of the pinned actions/checkout from v6.0.3 to v6.1.0 across all GitHub workflows and a composite action.

tests.evidence: No behavior change in the driver.

doc_comments.evidence: Only version comments beside the pinned SHA, updated consistently.

change_description.evidence: Renovate-generated description is adequate for a CI dependency bump; no changelog owed.

security.evidence: Supply-chain: a new pinned SHA for an action that runs with a token in release.yml and update_version; a glance that the SHA matches the v6.1.0 tag suffices.

backward_compat.evidence: No public API or user-visible behavior.

contradictions.evidence: Every occurrence updated to the same SHA and comment.

build_ci.evidence: CI dependency version changes in 14 workflow files, including release and snapshot publishing; mandated check that the minor release does not change checkout behavior (fetch-depth, persist-credentials, token handling).

plan.why: Mechanical CI dependency bump with a single required axis.
